summary: Frontend-only testing of the four requested behaviors: hidden /ext/drone/qr-code single-article page, Photography 'Selected work' wired to fotografie feed (empty->placeholder), Audio 'Selected work' wired to audio feed (empty->placeholder) with old placeholder images removed, and confirmation that /ext/drone/qr-code is not in nav. All four pass.

test_results.audio_selected_work_empty_placeholder: PASS - data-testid='audio-work-grid' loads and shows placeholder text. Old radio-studio / sound-design placeholder images are no longer present in the page HTML.

context_for_next_testing_agent: QR page uses two sequential fetches; needs networkidle + ~3s extra wait to render. fotografie/audio/qr/homepagina feeds are external and 'qr' currently has exactly 1 item (id 91c6c4d9-1735-41ec-a175-b97bc59305be, title 'Test').
